docks_module_description: Salvo dock time management: each dock's live state from the Salvo hardware, its sessions, and doors left open escalated to the planner and to a breakdown order.
docks_action_door_alert: {user} flagged {subject}: door open 40 minutes or more, a notice for the dock planner
docks_action_door_escalated: {user} escalated {subject}: door open an hour or more
docks_escalation_description: {dock}: possible fault in the sectional door, door open 60+ min
docks_no_docks_description: Managers add a site's docks on its customer's page.
docks_warning_unlocked: Truck at the dock without the Wheel-Lok: don't open the door.
docks_warning_fault: Fault: the SCP doesn't respond. Don't enter the dock until it's fixed.
docks_warning_amber: Door open 40+ minutes: energy loss and draught, the dock planner is notified.
docks_warning_red: Door open 60+ minutes: possible fault in the sectional door, a breakdown order is made.
docks_process_check_in: The driver checks in; Salvo assigns a free loading position.
docks_process_lock: The Wheel-Lok clamps the rear wheel: red light outside, green light inside.
docks_process_door: The sectional door unlocks only once the lock is confirmed; the open time is counted.
docks_process_check_out: The door closes, the Wheel-Lok releases, and the times are recorded on the session.
docks_signal_amber: 40–60 min: energy loss and draught, a notice to the dock planner.
docks_signal_red: Over 60 min: escalation, possible fault in the sectional door, a breakdown order.
docks_no_notices: No notices in the last day.
docks_card_description: This customer's dock positions and their live state.
docks_card_empty: No docks at this customer's sites.
docks_delete_description: Its live state, sessions and events go with it. Breakdown orders it made stay.

match.countPlural=one: This site has {countText} dock. Delete it on the Docks card first.
match.countPlural=*: This site has {countText} docks. Delete them on the Docks card first.

match.countPlural=one: This site still has {countText} dock. Switch Docks on and delete it on the Docks card first.
match.countPlural=*: This site still has {countText} docks. Switch Docks on and delete them on the Docks card first.

docks_form_code_hint: As the Salvo feed names it, e.g. DOCK 05.
docks_form_salvo_hint: Leave the SCP empty for a dock without Salvo.
docks_code_format: Letters, digits, spaces, dots and dashes, up to 32
docks_code_taken: Another dock already has this code
docks_unknown_site: Choose one of this customer's sites
docks_unit_elsewhere: Choose a unit at the dock's site
docks_location_elsewhere: Choose a location at the dock's site
docks_settings_description: The tokens the Salvo integration posts its events with, to {url}.
docks_tokens_managers: Only owners and admins make and revoke tokens.
docks_tokens_empty: No tokens yet: make one for the Salvo integration.
docks_token_name_required: Name the token, e.g. Salvo Barneveld
docks_token_created_description: It isn't shown again. The Salvo integration sends it as Authorization: Bearer <token>.
docks_token_revoke_description: The integration that uses it can't post events any more.
docks_settings_docks_description: The docks are kept on their customers' pages.
docks_usage_open_orders: Open breakdown orders from the door rules
docks_banner_intro: For each dock: whether the truck is locked with the Wheel-Lok, how long the sectional door has been open and which loading position is taken. Salvo links the lock to the door control: the door only opens once the wheel lock is on.
docks_note_loading: Wheel-Lok on, key in the SCP: loading.
docks_note_free: Key in key storage: ready for the next check-in.
docks_signal_amber_text: Energy loss and draught: a notice to the dock planner.
docks_signal_red_text: Escalation: possible fault in the sectional door, a breakdown order.
docks_components_title: Salvo Safety System — components at the dock
docks_component_scp: Controls the key release per loading position. Until the key is put back, the sectional door stays mechanically locked.
docks_component_storage: Keeps the Salvo keys of free docks. Taking one out is recorded and linked to the driver, the plate and the load.
docks_component_beacon: The dock's status on the spot: red (do not enter), orange (waiting for the lock), green (safe to load), off (dock free).
docks_components_note: The process stays as it is: check in → lock → door open → check out. Salvo adds key-bound safeguarding, so each step is physically enforced.
